transcript: Speaker A: पहली बेटी हुई तो बोला एक और... [When the first daughter was born, they said 'one more'... Zara shares her journey of being widowed at 23 with five daughters, rejected by family, and unable to get a job due to lack of English. She downloaded the English Seekho app for a 1 rupee trial, practiced with the AI coach, got a job, started a side business, and now earns 34,000 rupees a month, successfully raising her daughters.] ...मां बन गई हो तो शेर बन जाओ, और शेर को इंग्लिश आनी चाहिए, वरना जंगल में भी कोई नहीं सुनता। [If you have become a mother, become a lioness, and a lioness must know English, otherwise no one listens even in the jungle.] Speaker B: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
summary: A young widowed mother of five daughters shares her inspiring story of overcoming social rejection and financial hardship by learning English through the English Seekho app. After practicing with the app's AI coach, she secured a job and a side business, gaining financial independence. The ad ends with a call to action to download the app for a 1-rupee trial.
